Aviation simulation and training analytics for CAE's world-leading flight simulation business.

blocks.heading: Pharmaceutical and Life Sciences

sections.title: Québec and Bilingual AI Context
sections.description: French language and privacy regulations shaping Montréal AI.

blocks.heading: French Language Requirements (Loi 96 / Bill 96)
paragraphs: Québec's Charter of the French Language (strengthened by Bill 96) requires that workplace AI tools used by Québec employees be available in French. ClickMasters designs Montréal AI with French-language interface and documentation compliance in mind.

blocks.heading: PIPEDA (federal) + Québec Law 25
paragraphs: Québec's Law 25 (Act to Modernize Enterprise Provisions Relating to the Protection of Personal Information) imposes requirements equivalent to or stricter than PIPEDA for Québec private-sector organizations — including automated decision-making disclosure requirements that go beyond PIPEDA. ClickMasters designs Montréal AI with Law 25 compliance as a specific requirement.

blocks.heading: Bilingual Delivery
paragraphs: ClickMasters delivers Montréal AI projects with English and French documentation — user interfaces, API documentation, and technical specifications in both official languages where required.
